replacement.qe: May I inquire about your health?

findings.issue: English 'has success' is an unnatural calque even though the Russian collocation is valid.
'Does not have consciousness' is not idiomatic English and does not teach the normal loss-of-consciousness construction.
'I know his absence' / 'Я знаю его отсутствие' is not a natural or clear proposition in either language.
'Это золотое' is an incomplete substantivized adjective and does not naturally match predicate 'golden'.
'This is folk' / 'Это народное' leaves both adjectives without a noun and is not a usable matched example.
'This is informational' / 'Это информационное' is incomplete and the Russian reads as an omitted noun.
A one-time English intention is paired with imperfective переходить, producing an aspect mismatch.

replacement.qe: I cross this street every day.
replacement.ae: Я перехожу эту улицу каждый день.

findings.issue: 'Leading person' / 'ведущий человек' is an unnatural collocation in both languages.
The one-time imperative 'Repeat' is paired with imperfective polite повторяйте; a habitual sentence teaches the listed aspect cleanly.
English 'address this question' means deal with it, while обратиться к вопросу means turn to the topic.
'Let us discuss tomorrow' is a bounded proposal but Russian uses imperfective infinitive обсуждать after давайте.
'Её голос имел хороший тон' is a direct English calque and not natural Russian.
English 'is done' normally states completion, while Работа делается describes an ongoing process.
'Hit the goal' is not the same construction as попадать в цель and the modal sentence also clashes with the imperfective aspect.
крепко держится этого мнения is malformed; придерживаться is required for opinions, while крепко works naturally with a physical grip.
Одиночество трудно is grammatically malformed as a simple nominal predicate.
English 'digital image' is paired with цифровой образ, where образ is not the ordinary Russian word for a digital image.
'Gigantic strength' / 'сила гигантская' is an unnatural collocation and obscures the adjective.
'Throw out this' has incorrect English particle placement.
The Russian proposal Давайте болтать is unnatural for a single chat and encourages the wrong aspectual construction.
English says the sign is placed, while Russian says it must be placed; the modality was added only on one side.

replacement.qe: The sign must be placed here.

findings.issue: 'Is removed' is a resulting/state passive, while удаляется is ongoing/repeated removal.
English is present tense ('We reach') while Russian is future perfective ('доберёмся').
Generic English 'instance' does not mean Russian инстанция (an authority or organizational level), and 'The instance is here' is semantically empty.
English says 'I wash the sheet'; Russian says the sheet needs to be washed, changing both subject and modality.
подвергнуться лечению is an unnatural collocation for 'undergo treatment'; подвергнуться works naturally with changes or adverse action.
'He works three years consecutively' is ungrammatical for an ongoing duration.

replacement.qe: He has worked for three consecutive years.

findings.issue: hallway means коридор; прихожая is an entrance hall/entryway.
A single future event ('will rush by') is paired with the durative future будет проноситься.
'Works qualitatively' is not idiomatic English; it is a calque of Russian работает качественно.
English 'learned' says he acquired knowledge; Russian учился says he studied, so the outcomes differ.

replacement.qe: Little by little, he learned to read.

findings.issue: 'Smoking is to be prohibited here' is an unnatural prospective construction; Russian запрещается is the standard present prohibition.
A ward under guardianship is подопечный, not воспитанник (pupil/foster child); the tragedy context clearly invokes guardianship.

replacement.qe: He became his ward after the tragedy.
replacement.ae: После трагедии он стал его подопечным.

findings.issue: 'May collapse' suggests a possible complete event, while может рушиться suggests an ongoing/repeated process.
Звёзды насчитывают миллионы is grammatically wrong: насчитывать takes a collective/container subject and a count/object.

replacement.qe: The city numbers a million people.

findings.issue: English fugitive is a noun; беглый is an adjective and 'Беглый в лесу' is not a natural standalone noun phrase.

replacement.qe: The fugitive is in the forest.

findings.issue: The moral/spiritual noun 'redemption' is искупление; the current hostage example actually teaches ransom (выкуп) and uses unnatural English 'hostage's redemption'.
English bang is a noun in 'There was a bang'; бах is an interjection, and Было «бах» is not a natural matched noun sentence.
Переключение каналов трудно is grammatically awkward because the noun phrase needs an adjectival predicate or a predicative such as затруднительно.
Truthfulness as a personal quality is правдивость; истинность means truth/validity of a statement.
Проблема несуществующая is a marked, unnatural predicate construction.
Russian adds 'after victory', while English says 'at victory'; the temporal relation changes.
торговались за более низкую цену uses the wrong preposition/collocation.
'The plan showed inadequacy' / 'План показал несостоятельность' is an unnatural agency construction.
'Let's switch topics' requires a destination after переключиться; the Russian sentence is incomplete.
A good communicator is skilled at communicating; отличный собеседник means a good conversation partner, so the qualities are not equivalent.
Материнство трудно is grammatically malformed as a simple noun-plus-adverb predicate.
затрудняется с этим is an awkward calque; затрудняться normally governs an infinitive or в + prepositional.
вслушиваться requires an object with в; both examples are currently incomplete.

replacement.qe: She listens intently to his words.

findings.issue: Enchant/очаровать is transitive here but both examples omit the person affected.
English is past ('I saw') while Russian is present ('Я вижу').
перевалить через холм means cross/pass over a hill, not physically roll over it.

replacement.qe: The ball can roll over the hill.

findings.issue: Vocation means призвание; поприще means a field/sphere of activity.
довезти specifically means transport someone/something to a destination; generic 'deliver it' is broader and supplies no destination.
Tin as the metal is олово; жесть is tinplate/sheet metal. The generic headword and example teach the wrong material.
'Plenarium' is not normal modern English for пленум and should be repaired as a malformed headword.
мочевая проблема is an unnatural Russian collocation.
навеять радость is an unnatural collocation; навеять conventionally takes memories/thoughts/sleep/sadness.
'Kept her in remembrance' and хранил о ней память are both malformed collocations.
Events themselves are not 'chronological'; their list/order is chronological.
показал бодрость is not a natural collocation for 'showed vigor'.
English 'dug out a hole' is unidiomatic and usually means excavating something from a hole, while вырыли яму simply means dug a hole.
For a person, 'get into the swing of things' is войти во вкус; разыграться means become lively/intense and does not match this idiom.

replacement.q: get into the swing of things
replacement.qe: She will get into the swing of things soon.

findings.issue: генеральский план strongly reads as a master/development plan, not 'a general's plan'; the current example is a false-friend trap.
English transitive 'arm' omits the reflexive object that Russian вооружиться explicitly supplies.

replacement.qe: They decided to arm themselves quickly.

findings.issue: English says Cinderella lost one shoe; Russian обувь is collective footwear and changes the concrete meaning.
рассмешить specifically means make someone laugh, while generic 'amuse' can merely entertain; the context does not select the narrower sense.
лелеять моменты is an unnatural Russian collocation; one cherishes memories.
English says she painted the wall (applied paint); Russian says she drew/painted on the wall, changing the action.

replacement.qe: She painted on the wall artistically.

findings.issue: A one-time obligation 'must warn' is paired with imperfective предостерегать.
English static/result passive 'is depicted' is paired with ongoing/repeated изображается.

replacement.qe: The scene is being depicted here.

findings.issue: Russian adds скоро ('soon'), which is absent from English.
'Bite off bread' / откусить хлеб omits the piece that the verb requires in this construction.

replacement.qe: He will bite off a piece of bread.

findings.issue: Medicine 'potency' is сила действия/эффективность; лекарство имеет большую силу is a bad literal collocation.
English weekday is a noun; Russian будний is an adjective, and 'Будний поезд' is not a meaningful match.
Проденьте нить is incomplete and omits the needle; 'thread the needle' means put thread through its eye.
'Tangibly strong pain' / ощутимо сильна is unnatural in both languages.
религиозно молилась is a redundant/unidiomatic adverbial pairing; набожно expresses devotional manner.
поступает уместно is not a natural Russian collocation.
небрежная ошибка is an unnatural attributive collocation for 'careless error'.
A written register is журнал/реестр; регистр means register/range in linguistics, music, typography, or machinery. 'в регистр' is also grammatically wrong here.

replacement.qe: Write your name in the register.

findings.issue: 'He realized it' means Он осознал это; спохватился means he suddenly remembered/reacted, usually belatedly.
Sexual intercourse is normally половые отношения/половой акт; singular сношение is unnatural in this sentence.
English says 'overheard' but Russian услыхал only says heard; the extra English synonym is not supported by the answer.
The noun phrase 'blast furnace' is доменная печь; доменный alone is only the adjective 'blast-furnace'.
слетать means make a quick/round-trip flight; directional 'fly down' is слететь, so the current future meanings differ.
Generic 'decoration' is украшение; роспись is painted ornament/mural work, and the current generic example does not select that sense.
The ordinary modern Russian word for heel is пятка; пята is archaic/bookish and makes the everyday pain sentence unnatural.
'Spoke insistently' / говорил настоятельно is an unnatural collocation in both languages; настоятельно normally modifies a request/recommendation.

replacement.qe: He insistently asked for an answer.
